+def test_testclient_response_debug_extension(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    info = {"custom": {"nested": True}}
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        await send({"type": "http.response.debug", "info": info})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.body"})
+
+    response = test_client_factory(app).get("/")
+
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == info
+
+
+def test_testclient_response_debug_template_compatibility(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    template = object()
+    context = {"name": "world"}
+    info = {"template": template, "context": context, "custom": "value"}
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        await send({"type": "http.response.debug", "info": info})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.body"})
+
+    response = test_client_factory(app).get("/")
+
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == info
+    assert response.template is template  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert response.context is context  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
